title: GL.iNet cloud remote-management compromise of routers and KVMs
summary: GL.iNet confirmed unauthorized exploitation of its cloud remote-management service to install malware on some routers and KVM devices. The cloud attack path was blocked, but previously infected devices require separate checks and remediation; stable security firmware was scheduled for November 22, with availability not independently confirmed.

rootCause.summary: A vulnerability in GL.iNet cloud remote management allowed unauthorized access and malware installation on some managed devices.

sources.label: GL.iNet November 20 security notice, updated November 21

history.summary: GL.iNet disclosed active exploitation of cloud remote management and said the cloud vulnerability and attack path were blocked. It provided a malware process indicator and KVM beta firmware, while stable firmware remained scheduled.
